project.name: ReviewHub
project.description: Internal Customer Experience & Review Management Platform - A comprehensive solution for collecting customer reviews, sending surveys, managing online reputation, and providing AI-powered analytics. Designed to replace Experience.com/Birdeye with a custom solution.

epics.name: Foundation & Infrastructure
epics.description: Core project setup, authentication, and database schema

epics.name: Survey & Review Collection
epics.description: Automated survey system with email/SMS distribution

epics.name: Dashboard & Analytics
epics.description: User dashboards, metrics, and performance insights

epics.name: AI Integration
epics.description: Sentiment analysis, insights, and AI-powered features

epics.name: Mobile Application
epics.description: React Native mobile app for on-the-go management

stories.title: Initialize Next.js 16 Project with ShadCN
stories.description: Set up Next.js 16 with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN/UI components. Configure ESLint, Prettier, and project structure. Establish design system foundations for professional UI quality.
acceptance_criteria: Next.js 16 project initialized with TypeScript and React 19
Tailwind CSS configured with custom theme matching design system
ShadCN/UI installed with base components (Button, Card, Input, Form)
Project folder structure established per architecture docs
Design system color palette and spacing defined in Tailwind config
Typography scale configured for consistent hierarchy

stories.title: Supabase Project Setup & Database Schema
stories.description: Initialize Supabase project, create database schema for all core entities including organizations, users, loan officers, surveys, reviews, and analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Database migrations created for all core tables

stories.title: Authentication System
stories.description: Implement authentication using Supabase Auth with email/password and magic link options. Include role-based access control for Admin, Manager, and LoanOfficer roles.
acceptance_criteria: Sign up flow with email verification
Sign in with email/password and magic link

stories.title: Base Layout & Navigation
stories.description: Create the main application layout with responsive navigation, sidebar for dashboard views, and mobile-friendly design.
acceptance_criteria: Top navigation bar with user menu

stories.title: Survey Builder & Templates
stories.description: Create a survey builder that allows creating customizable survey templates with various question types (rating, NPS, text, multiple choice).
acceptance_criteria: Question types: Star rating, NPS (0-10), Text, Multiple choice
gates: Survey templates save and load correctly

stories.title: Public Survey Form
stories.description: Build the public-facing survey form page that customers access via unique links. Must be mobile-optimized and support all question types.
acceptance_criteria: Public survey page with unique token-based URLs
Thank you page with optional review redirect

stories.title: Email Service Integration with Resend
stories.description: Integrate Resend for transactional emails including survey invitations, reminders, and notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Email templates for new review notifications

stories.title: Automated Survey Distribution System
stories.description: Build the automation engine that sends survey invitations based on triggers (loan closure, webhook) with automatic follow-up reminders.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook endpoint for external triggers (loan closure)
Survey send throttling and rate limiting
Manual survey send option for admins

stories.title: Review Approval Workflow
stories.description: Implement a workflow for reviewing and approving survey responses before publishing as public testimonials.
acceptance_criteria: Notification to LO on new reviews

stories.title: Loan Officer Dashboard
stories.description: Create the main dashboard for Loan Officers showing their reviews, ratings, metrics, and performance indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Overview cards (total reviews, avg rating, NPS, response rate)

stories.title: Manager Dashboard
stories.description: Build the manager dashboard with team-level analytics, LO comparisons, and performance oversight capabilities.
gates: Manager can view all team members

stories.title: Analytics Engine
stories.description: Implement the core analytics engine that calculates NPS, CSAT, response rates, and other key metrics.

stories.title: Gamification & Leaderboards
stories.description: Add gamification elements including leaderboards, badges, and reputation scores to drive engagement.
acceptance_criteria: Achievement badges (first review, 50 reviews, top performer)
Leaderboard filters (by branch, region, time period)

stories.title: Reporting & Export
stories.description: Build reporting features for generating and exporting performance reports in various formats.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-built report templates (Monthly Performance, Team Summary)

stories.title: Google Business Profile Integration
stories.description: Integrate with Google Business Profile API to fetch and manage Google reviews.
acceptance_criteria: OAuth connection to Google Business account
Fetch Google reviews for connected locations
Store Google reviews in unified review table
Reply to Google reviews from platform

stories.title: Review Aggregation Dashboard
stories.description: Create a unified view of all reviews from all sources (internal surveys, Google, etc.) in one dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Combined review feed from all sources
Review detail modal with full context

stories.title: Review Response Management
stories.description: Build tools for managing and responding to reviews across all platforms from a single interface.

stories.title: Alert & Notification System
stories.description: Implement a comprehensive notification system for new reviews, mentions, and important events.
acceptance_criteria: Instant alerts for negative reviews (< 3 stars)

stories.title: Sentiment Analysis Engine
stories.description: Integrate AI-powered sentiment analysis for review text using OpenAI API.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAI API integration for sentiment analysis
gates: Sentiment scores align with manual assessment

stories.title: AI Insights Dashboard
stories.description: Create a dashboard showing AI-generated insights including trends, common themes, and improvement suggestions.

stories.title: AI Response Suggestions
stories.description: Implement AI-powered response suggestions for reviews using OpenAI API.
acceptance_criteria: Generate response suggestions based on review content
Multiple response tone options (professional, friendly, apologetic)
Response templates based on review sentiment

stories.title: Testimonial Generator
stories.description: Build an AI-powered tool that creates marketing-ready testimonial snippets from reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Extract key quotes from positive reviews

stories.title: Expo Project Setup
stories.description: Initialize React Native project with Expo, configure navigation, and set up shared component library.
acceptance_criteria: Shared UI components (matching web ShadCN style)
gates: App runs on iOS and Android simulators

stories.title: Mobile Dashboard
stories.description: Build the mobile version of the LO dashboard with key metrics and recent reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard home screen with key metrics

stories.title: Mobile Survey Request
stories.description: Allow LOs to send survey requests directly from their mobile device.

stories.title: Webhook System
stories.description: Build a webhook system for receiving events from external systems (LOS, CRM) to trigger actions.
acceptance_criteria: Support for multiple event types (loan.closed, contact.created)

stories.title: Public API
stories.description: Create a public REST API for programmatic access to reviews and metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints: GET reviews, GET metrics, POST survey request

stories.title: WordPress Integration Plugin
stories.description: Create a WordPress plugin to display reviews on LO profile pages via shortcodes or widgets.

stories.title: Embeddable Widget
stories.description: Build an embeddable JavaScript widget for displaying reviews on any website.
gates: Widget loads correctly on third-party sites

stories.title: Zapier Integration
stories.description: Build Zapier triggers and actions for integration with thousands of apps.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers: New Review, New Survey Response, Low Rating Alert
Actions: Send Survey Request, Create Contact

stories.title: Multi-tenant Organization Support
stories.description: Implement full multi-tenant support for future SaaS offering with organization-level isolation.

stories.title: SEO Optimization & Structured Data
stories.description: Implement SEO features including structured data (schema.org) for reviews and LO profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic meta tags for profile pages
gates: Google Search Console shows rich results

phases.name: Foundation (MVP)
phases.description: Core infrastructure, authentication, and basic survey/review functionality

plugins.notes: Establish patterns that later phases will follow. Prioritize solid foundations.

phases.name: Enhanced Features
phases.description: Manager dashboards, Google integration, approval workflows, and analytics

recommended_for.S015: feature-dev:code-explorer (Understand existing auth before Google integration)

plugins.notes: Reuse Phase 1 patterns. Dashboard stories need polished UI via /frontend-design.

recommended_for.S019: feature-dev:code-architect (Sentiment analysis sets AI patterns for S020-S022)

plugins.notes: AI code complexity requires aggressive simplification. Review all AI integrations for security and rate limiting.

phases.name: Mobile & Integrations
phases.description: Mobile app, public API, integrations, and widgets

plugins.notes: Mobile UI must feel native. Widgets must be lightweight. API design should prioritize extensibility.

global_gates: All TypeScript strict mode enabled with no errors
All API routes have proper error handling
RLS policies cover all database tables
Responsive design works on mobile devices

security.data: Row Level Security on all tables
security.api: Rate limiting and API key authentication
